question: The third Buddhist Council was held by:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ashoka**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The third council, held during the reign of **the emperor Aśoka** at his capital, Patliputra, about 247 bc, may have been confined to an assembly of the Theravādas.
 
• **Ashoka the Great**, was an Indian emperor of the Maurya Empire, son of Bindusara, who ruled almost the entire Indian subcontinent from c. 268 to 232 BC
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cce62004e4fe1d1d0671bba393bc862342fe75cb47e29d7d4086f214098e3584.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kanishka I, or Kanishka the Great,** was an** emperor of the Kushan dynasty,** under whose reign the empire reached its zenith. He is famous for his military, political, and spiritual achievements.
 
• **Chandragupta **was the **founder of the Mauryan dynasty** (reigned c. 321–c. 297 BCE) and the first emperor to unify most of India under one administration. He is credited with saving the country from maladministration and freeing it from foreign domination.
 
• **Harshavardhana ** was an **Indian emperor who ruled northern India from 606 to 647 CE**. He was a member of the Vardhana dynasty, who defeated the Alchon Huna invaders.
